version.changelog:
v1.0.0: the family is now AI KEY

Commands go from /zmm-… to /aikey-…, display names carry the AI KEY
brand, and the byline is the account name 澳洲AI教父. Judgements, flows
and rules are untouched — this release contains names and nothing else,
so if a channel breaks, the cause is unambiguous.

Old links keep working: the repo rename redirects, and the bundle ships
under both aikey-toolbox.zip and the old zmm-toolbox.zip.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed local tracking/memory aid for due items and commitments, with no bundled executable code or hidden external behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The artifact scopes file access to configured tracking and memory paths and instructs the agent not to store sensitive details such as amounts or real customer names.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The markdown includes user-run migration/install examples using unpinned npx commands, but they are not automatic runtime behavior and no executable package content is bundled in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include ordinary language and the skill defaults unclear requests to a check mode, which can surface local tracking records if invoked unintentionally, but this behavior is disclosed and tied to the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates long-lived local records and memory entries for reminders and calibration; this persistence is disclosed, purpose-aligned, and includes a warning that files remain on disk.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes tracking commitments, expiry dates, watch items, in-flight work, and queues; reading and writing local tracking and memory files is coherent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this skill to maintain local long-term reminder and commitment records. Use explicit commands when possible, avoid storing sensitive names or financial details, and review any npx install or migration command before running it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad natural-language triggers are real and could cause accidental activation, but surfacing due items and prior work is the core function rather than hidden behavior.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned npx examples are installation/migration guidance, not code executed by the skill; users should still prefer pinned or trusted install sources.
[SQP-3] expected: The required Chinese interaction spec matches the primarily Chinese artifact and product framing, though bilingual users should know the runtime style is mostly Chinese.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF has no results and the inspected artifact is a single non-executable Markdown skill file.
